acceptance.declaration: Written before the first solve of the explicit bipolar morphology; no human or engineered-cell calibration is claimed.
acceptance.parameterRationale: The bipolar topology and soma range follow the requested architecture. Stem geometry is explicitly hypothetical. Each arm uses a tabulated MRG motor-fiber geometry rather than extrapolating that table. Soma and stems use 10% of the nodal active conductance densities as a declared distributed-membrane hypothesis; it is not a measured density or a fitted value. Published nodal leak and reversal potentials are unchanged. The density grid tests this assumption, including the original nodal-density extreme. Fifty milliseconds is a declared numerical preparation, not a balancing current.
acceptance.controls: Unmodified shared equilibrium, zero drive, local active-conductance removal in soma/both stems/one heminode each arm, all active sites removed, and separately disconnected native-arm stumps. A missing relay junction is not fabricated. Negative causal results are retained, not forced to pass.
acceptance.failurePolicy: Every failed numerical attempt and every spontaneous or nonrecruited sensitivity case remains recorded. Physiological feasibility is not a numerical pass criterion. Numerical limits will not be relaxed to hide a failure.

resolutionCorrection.reason: Refine numerical integration after the maximum per-site error exceeded the unchanged 1 mV criterion; retain the endpoint and the failed study. No channel or geometry parameter was adjusted to pass.

somaResolutionCorrection.reason: The declared actual-well axial refinement study failed at one and three bands. Five bands were the first candidate with two consecutive passing comparisons. This is a numerical resolution change, not a change to anatomical dimensions, conductance densities or acceptance tolerances.
somaResolutionCorrection.prototypeFieldStatus: exploratory; final field reference and same-grid refinement required before authoritative certification
